methylseg.MultinomialSegHMM

class methylseg.MultinomialSegHMM(n_states, random_state=42, n_iter=30, alpha=0.7)[source]

Bases: MethylSegHMM

Discrete multinomial HMM over categorical methylation state labels.

Parameters:

  • n_states (int)

  • random_state (int)

  • n_iter (int)

  • alpha (float)

__init__(n_states, random_state=42, n_iter=30, alpha=0.7)[source]

Initialize a multinomial HMM for discrete state observations.

Parameters:

  • n_states (int) – Number of hidden and observed categorical states.

  • random_state (int) – Random seed passed to the underlying HMM implementation.

  • n_iter (int) – Maximum number of expectation-maximization iterations.

  • alpha (float) – Compatibility smoothing parameter retained for this backend.
